verdict.rationale: Direct probes found a real robots.txt returning HTTP 200 on both the Commission's main site and the Clerk's Information System, so an agent can learn its permissions before fetching anything. The answer is unambiguous: both files carry "Disallow: /" for all agents, meaning nothing may be read. Missing for 10: no granular per-path allow rules or sitemap pointers, since the file only signals a blanket ban rather than describing readable content.
